title: Input
content:
Input

Provides input handling for entities.

Component Common

Schema

JSON
{
  "input": {
    "provider": "providerType"
  }
}

Description

The Input component provides input handling for entities. It connects an entity to an input provider, allowing it to receive and respond to player input or other input sources.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
providerstringThe input provider type that supplies input data to the entity.

Example

JSON
{
  "input": {
    "provider": "player1"
  }
}
